slides.title: Paterson Great Falls
slides.body: Paterson was founded in 1792 as America's first planned industrial city, built around these falls on the Passaic River.

slides.title: The Paterson Museum
slides.body: It's inside the old Rogers Locomotive Works. See John P. Holland's early submarines and Colt firearms.

slides.title: Danforth Memorial Library
slides.body: Paterson's main public library opened in 1905 and is on the National Register of Historic Places.

slides.title: Your free Paterson day
slides.tip: Looking at homes in Paterson? NJ Transit's Main Line stops at Paterson station.
